```{r render test, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
# Render daily dashboard and specify output file location
if ("Presidents" %in% list.files("/SharedDrive/")) {
  user_directory <- paste0("/SharedDrive/deans/Presidents/HSPI-PM/",
                           "Operations Analytics and Optimization/Projects/",
                           "Service Lines/Lab KPI/Data")
} else {
  user_directory <- paste0("/SharedDrive/deans/Presidents/HSPI-PM/",
                           "Operations Analytics and Optimization/Projects/",
                           "Service Lines/Lab KPI/Data")
}

rmarkdown::render("Lab KPI Daily Dashboard Prelim Run.Rmd", 
                  output_dir = paste0(user_directory,"/Prelim Dashboard Output/"),
                  output_file = paste0("Lab KPI Prelim Dashboard ", format(Sys.time(),format = "%m/%d/%y")))
```
